status_definitions.DONE: The point-in-time acceptance condition has inspected evidence.
status_definitions.OPEN: Project work or qualification evidence is still required.
status_definitions.BLOCKED_LOCAL: The current audit host cannot execute the path; this is not a product PASS.
status_definitions.BLOCKED_EXTERNAL: A genuinely independent external party is required; the implementer cannot self-attest it.
status_definitions.BLOCKED_BY_GATES: The item must not proceed until its listed prerequisite gates are closed.

artifact.name: tomorrowci-ci-evidence
artifact.scope_note: This verifies artifact download and listed-file integrity only; it is not replay execution or independent verification.

items.summary: Add a safe first-class verify command and versioned required evidence inventory.
items.baseline_evidence: The baseline CLI has no verify subcommand; public run 31185394369 did not execute verify.
items.acceptance: scan -> verify succeeds for valid bundles; verification parses fixed data only and never executes target-controlled bytes.

items.summary: Finalize checksums after all writers and reject incomplete, extra, mutated, duplicate, or unsafe paths.
items.baseline_evidence: The downloaded CI artifact's listed files were internally consistent, but the baseline does not prove the required-inventory and late-writer boundary or the specified negative cases.
items.acceptance: CLI negative tests reject mutation, deletion, unlisted required files, listed missing files, duplicate or illegal paths, symlink/reparse traversal, absolute paths, parent traversal, and identity mismatch.

items.summary: Execute two manifest-bound replays and verify equivalence without rediscovery or replanning.
items.baseline_evidence: Run 31185394369 performed measure/scan only. Replay text in its output is a suggested command, not execution evidence.
items.acceptance: scan -> verify -> replay x2 -> verify passes for Python, Node, and Rust fixtures, with immutable per-attempt evidence and non-equivalence failing closed.

items.summary: Bind source, config, workspace, engine, image tag/digest, timestamps, reports, and replay attempts into the verified model.
items.baseline_evidence: Current fixture evidence is useful scan evidence but has not passed the new closed identity and replay contract.
items.acceptance: Cross-mixed identities and fabricated timestamps are rejected; reports and SARIF derive from the verified model and escape target-controlled text.

items.summary: Make doctor fail closed while preserving an explicit expected no-engine classification.
items.baseline_evidence: The default CI doctor step uses a tolerated failure; locally doctor exited 4 and also misreported npm despite host npm 12.0.2.
items.acceptance: CI distinguishes an expected no-engine outcome from a doctor defect without continue-on-error or an unconditional success override.

items.summary: Add required Linux, Windows, and macOS CLI/package smoke plus web tests/build to default CI.
items.baseline_evidence: Default run 31185394369 is Ubuntu-centered and has no web job; web checks passed only on the local Windows audit host.
items.acceptance: All three OS jobs build and exercise the packaged CLI, and required web install/test/build gates run on the exact candidate SHA.

items.summary: Run the live fixture contract with Podman in required CI.
items.baseline_evidence: Podman is missing on the local host, and the inspected public container job used Docker 28.0.4 only.
items.acceptance: A public exact-SHA Podman job runs the required fixture/verify/replay contract and uploads inspectable evidence.

items.summary: Add required dependency/security audit and substantive schema validation to default CI.
items.baseline_evidence: The inspected schema job checks only that the schema file exists; no dedicated dependency/security audit job was inspected.
items.acceptance: Pinned audit tooling and schema validation run on the exact candidate SHA with a documented, fail-closed policy.

items.summary: Local live container rerun is unavailable on the current Windows audit host.
items.baseline_evidence: Docker CLI 29.6.2 is installed but the daemon is unavailable; Podman command is missing; doctor exits 4.
items.acceptance: Re-run locally only after a working daemon/engine is available; do not convert this blocker into a product PASS.

items.summary: Resolve or explicitly gate the five npm audit findings.
items.baseline_evidence: npm ci completed but reported 3 moderate, 1 high, and 1 critical vulnerability.
items.acceptance: The release policy records and enforces an approved vulnerability result on the candidate lockfile.

items.summary: Qualify historical backtest against pinned, content-addressed Python, npm, and Cargo registry snapshots.
items.baseline_evidence: No inspected baseline evidence proves historical registry/index reconstruction.
items.acceptance: Pinned source plus pinned registry snapshot replays for all three ecosystems, and missing snapshots fail closed as INCONCLUSIVE or SCHEDULED_RISK.

items.summary: Implement and qualify an ecosystem weather map derived only from verified runs.
items.baseline_evidence: No inspected baseline evidence closes the north-star weather-map acceptance criteria.
items.acceptance: JSON and human reports share one typed model and preserve denominator, selection policy, coverage, uncertainty, BLOCKED, and UNSUPPORTED outcomes.

items.summary: Implement and qualify the isolated patch laboratory without rewriting original verdicts.
items.baseline_evidence: No inspected baseline evidence closes the north-star patch-lab acceptance criteria.
items.acceptance: A patch runs in a new disposable sandbox and produces separately verifiable evidence linked to the immutable original run and diff.

items.summary: Implement and qualify the versioned adapter SDK, conformance suite, and least-privilege plugin boundary.
items.baseline_evidence: No inspected baseline evidence closes the north-star adapter-SDK acceptance criteria.
items.acceptance: Built-in adapters and a minimal external example pass version, capability, compatibility, and security rejection tests.

items.summary: Qualify every documented CLI command and bounded remote GitHub scan path end to end.
items.baseline_evidence: The inspected public run exercises local fixtures and Action dogfood; it does not close all documented CLI commands or the bounded remote-clone security contract.
items.acceptance: Executable acceptance covers documented commands, all three ecosystems, supported/unsupported classification, allowlisted HTTPS GitHub URLs, redirects, submodules/LFS/credential boundaries, resource limits, resolved origin, and exact cloned SHA.

items.summary: Produce a macOS archive whose name, target, and Mach-O architecture agree.
items.baseline_evidence: The existing x86_64-apple-darwin archive contains an arm64 Mach-O binary.
items.acceptance: Clean extraction and architecture inspection on macOS match the declared target, followed by CLI version/doctor/report/verify smoke.

items.summary: Generate a real CycloneDX or SPDX SBOM and fail release creation if generation fails.
items.baseline_evidence: The existing 219-byte CycloneDX file has zero components while Cargo.lock has 105 packages.
items.acceptance: Schema-valid SBOM contains exact locked packages and versions; no placeholder or best-effort fallback is accepted.

items.summary: Cover the exact release inventory with one verified checksum manifest.
items.baseline_evidence: The existing SHA256SUMS.txt verifies the three archives but omits sbom.cdx.json.
items.acceptance: Publish accepts an exact allowlisted inventory and verifies every required payload asset before upload; extra or missing files fail.

items.summary: Require full acceptance, version identity, deterministic packaging, provenance, and clean-download read-back before publish.
items.baseline_evidence: The historical five-asset release has no provenance asset and is not tied to the current default SHA.
items.acceptance: A dry-run candidate from the exact merged SHA passes required CI, reproducibility, checksum, SBOM, attestation, three-platform extraction, and verify/replay read-back gates.

items.summary: Replace the stale GitHub Action dogfood NOT_RUN claim with exact public evidence.
items.baseline_evidence: Action dogfood job 92889107297 passed on run 31185394369 at exact SHA 1f42003a561630164699f94f274727be23f2c1a8.
items.acceptance: CLAIM_EVIDENCE.md links the exact run/job and does not generalize the result beyond that SHA.

items.summary: Pre-register and run one non-project-owned public repository per supported ecosystem on the final candidate.
items.baseline_evidence: The six inspected runs are project fixtures on project-operated CI, not an external corpus.
items.acceptance: Python, Node, and Rust target runs preserve pre-registration, exact source SHA, candidate digest, engine/image identity, raw evidence, and verified outcomes without cherry-picking.

items.summary: Obtain one genuinely independent downstream maintainer or auditor replay against the final exact candidate.
items.baseline_evidence: No independent adopter/auditor evidence was inspected. Project-owned CI and another agent cannot satisfy this trust root.
items.acceptance: An independent party publishes an exact-candidate scan/verify/replay result with repository/commit, tool artifact digest, engine/image digest, evidence hash, result, and identity.

items.summary: Do not create a new stable tag or release yet.
items.baseline_evidence: The baseline has open technical gates, old release defects, missing verify/replay evidence, missing Podman evidence, and a genuinely external blocker.
items.acceptance: All prerequisite items are closed on the exact merged default SHA, then the annotated tag, promoted assets, public release workflow, and clean-download read-back all match the audited candidate.
